aiOverview.content: Several school districts in Central and Southwest Virginia, including Bedford, Campbell, and Lynchburg, are closed due to severe weather as of March 16–17, 2026. Other areas, such as Grayson and Highland counties, have reported 2-hour delays, with some opting for virtual learning days. Closures are often announced early in the morning or the night before. Recent School Closings and Delays (March 17, 2026): Bedford County Public Schools: Closed. Campbell County Public Schools: Closed. Halifax County Public Schools: Closed. Lynchburg City Schools: Closed. Grayson County Public Schools: 2-hour delay; also reporting virtual learning days. Highland County Schools: 2-hour delay. Central NY (Oswego/Adirondack): Some early dismissals reported. Key Information Sources: WFXRtv: Provides a real-time list of closures in Virginia. WSLS 10: Features updates on local school and business closings. WHSV 3: Lists delays for specific school districts like Highland County. For the most up-to-date information, check your local school district’s website, official social media channels, or local television news alerts.
